resources.string: MusicFlame uses the following open-source libraries. Each one keeps its own license; MusicFlame\'s own code is © 2026 ShimuroNaga, all rights reserved.

MusicFlame uses JAudioTagger to write tags (cover art, title, artist, album) into audio files. JAudioTagger is distributed under the GNU LGPL 2.1 or later. It is used as a separate, unmodified library; its source code and full license are available at the links above.
Firebase, Google Sign-In and the Google API libraries are used under Google\'s terms of service.
